data.name: Akshay
data.gender_notes: Akshay is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + kṣi, 'to perish' — 'imperishable'. Its root is Sanskrit a + kṣi. A classical Sanskrit term for the imperishable. Akshay is a Sanskrit name meaning “Imperishable; indestructible; eternal”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Akshay expresses “Imperishable; indestructible; eternal”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit a, 'not', + kṣi, 'to perish' — 'imperishable'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Akshay total 20, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.

The name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘अक्षय’, which means ‘Imperishable’, ‘Immortal’, ‘Invincible’, ‘Undefeated’, ‘Indestructible’.
